title: Zorb vs the Number From 300 to 850 That Judges You
description:
Zorb discovers the credit score: a number that predicts how likely Earthlings are to pay a loan back on time. Score ranges and uses come from the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau, and the score's parts come from FICO.

Education, not financial advice.

#Shorts #creditscore #personalfinance

beats.line: Stop. Your loan rate hangs on a number from 300 to 850. How?
This number predicts how likely you are to pay a loan back on time.
Lenders use it to say yes or no, and to pick your rate and credit limit.
FICO cooks it like a recipe. The biggest part, 35 percent, is paying on time.
Next, 30 percent is how much you owe.
Then 15 percent for credit history length, 10 for the mix, 10 for new credit.
Twist: you do not have one score. It changes with the model, the data, even the day.
Zorb will return. Earth money remains confusing.
